caseName: Mid-Con Freight Systems, Inc. v. Michigan Public Service Commission
caseNameFull: Mid-Con Freight Systems, Inc., Et Al. v. Michigan Public Service Commission Et Al.

opinions.text: Ct. App. Mich. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Whether the $100 fee upon vehicles operating solely in interstate commerce is preempted by 49 U. S. C. § 14504.”
